name: B10-0217/2024 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: PROPOSAL FOR A DECISION on setting up a special committee on the Housing Crisis in the European Union, and defining its responsibilities, numerical strength and term of office
part_text:
The European Parliament is setting up a temporary committee to look into the housing crisis across the European Union. It will study why decent, affordable homes are scarce and what housing policies exist, including social housing, short-term rentals and renovation. It will hear from experts, visit places to learn good practices, and propose solutions. The committee has 33 members and runs for 12 months. It will end with a final report.

- A new 33-member committee starts work for 12 months and ends with a final report.
- It affects people across the EU struggling with high housing prices and scarcity.
- Next: the committee meets, studies housing, hears experts and proposes solutions.
